@graph.headline: 7 Help Scout Alternatives for Support Teams in 2026
@graph.description: Compare seven Help Scout alternatives by inbox, ticketing, AI pricing, knowledge base, free access and migration so you can choose a support tool for your team.

mainEntity.name: Does Help Scout have a free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Help Scout's Free plan includes up to five users, one Inbox, one Docs site and 100 contacts per month, according to its official guide checked November 20, 2026.

mainEntity.name: Which Help Scout alternative has a free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zoho Desk lists a Free edition for up to three users, and Crisp lists a Free plan for two seats. Help Scout also has a Free plan. Check each vendor's current limits.

mainEntity.name: Is Zendesk or Freshdesk a better replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zendesk is worth comparing for structured routing, analytics and a wider service suite. Freshdesk is a good first comparison for conventional ticketing with a portal and knowledge base.

mainEntity.name: Does Intercom charge for each AI resolution?

acceptedAnswer.text: Intercom lists Fin at US$0.99 per outcome, with seat charges separate, on its pricing page checked November 20, 2026.

mainEntity.name: Can I move Help Scout conversations to another help desk?

acceptedAnswer.text: The destination determines the import route. Zendesk documents API import for tickets, users, organizations and articles. Test a sample and check attachments, history, tags and custom fields.

mainEntity.name: Is a flat workspace price always cheaper?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Compare included seats, workspace count, extra agent charges, usage fees and plan limits. A workspace price is not automatically lower for every team size.
